title: GBN-AG PIMS consumer schema (v0.4.0)
description: Consumer-specific schema published to PIMS for the GBN-AG event payload. What changed from the previous version, and why, is in gbn-ag-pims-v0.4.0-changes.md beside this file. Core envelope infrastructure is composed via event-envelope-v1.

referenceDocument.description: The accompanying documents, such as the veterinary health certificate. See docs/analysis/gbn-ag-field-lineage.md §3 and pims-data-mapping.md 'Accompanying Document: Type/Reference/Date of Issue'.

finalDestinationLocation.description: The CPH (County Parish Holding) number of the destination farm, on `identifier`, with `urlId` naming the Defra-curated CPH register. It reuses `logisticsLocation` rather than a CPH-specific shape: the generic event's own `finalDestinationLocation.postalAddress` is never populated either (no agreed source for which address belongs to the holding), so `postalAddress` is not required. See docs/analysis/gbn-ag-field-lineage.md §3.

transitTradeCountry.description: The countries the consignment passes through between origin and destination. See docs/analysis/gbn-ag-field-lineage.md §3 and pims-data-mapping.md 'Transition Countries'.

codedValue.description: A code with its `urlId` and `name`, the human-readable label for the code.

referencedDocument.description: A document reference: an accompanying document on `exchangedDocument.referenceDocument[]`, or a transport document on `transportContractRelatedReferencedDocument[]`. `urlId` names the list `typeCode` is drawn from. An accompanying document's `typeCode` is from https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/gbn-ag-document-types (schemas/codelists/gbn-ag-document-types.json). A link to open the stored file is not carried.

tradeParty.description: A party, including `partyRoleCode` and `definedContact`. Used for every party role (consignor, consignee, despatch, delivery, importer, carrier and, via `tradeProductInstance.permanentLocation` below, the per-animal permanent-address party).

tradeCountry.description: A country on the consignment. Only `originCountry` carries `subordinateTradeCountrySubDivision` and `regionOfOriginCode`, the two facts that say where in the country the animals came from. A whole-country origin carries neither.

regionOfOriginCode.description: The region of origin code from the health certificate: a disease-control zone, such as one under EU regionalisation measures. It is not the subdivision, and cannot be derived from it. Present only when the notifier says the certificate carries one.

tradeCountrySubDivision.description: The country subdivision the animals came from, such as the Canary Islands, as the `106` (UNCL3227 location function) entry a TRACES CHED uses. `identifier` is the MDM subdivision code, such as `ES-CN`, and `urlId` names the MDM subdivision list, https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/country_subdivisions, because those codes are not all ISO 3166-2. The region of origin code is a separate field on `tradeCountry`. A single object. Narrower than the generic schema's `TradeCountrySubDivision`: only the `106` case is sent, so the competent-authority and customs-office cases and their `activityAuthorizedParty` list are not modelled.

logisticsLocation.description: A location, including `urlId`, `name`, `typeCode` and `postalAddress`. Used for `unloadingBaseportLocation` and `finalDestinationLocation` above — see that property's own description for why `postalAddress` isn't required.

clause.description: A coded declaration clause on `exchangedDocument.firstSignatoryAuthentication.includedClause[]`. `content` is a code from a published list, and `urlId` names that list. `PURPOSE` (the reason for import): https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/gbn-ag-purposes. `INTERNAL_MARKET_PURPOSE`, present only when the `PURPOSE` content is `INTERNAL_MARKET`: https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/gbn-ag-internal-market-purposes. `GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS`: https://refdata.tbc.defra.gov.uk/gbn-ag-goods-certified-as. The lists are in schemas/codelists/ in this repo. A list reuses the TRACES ched_consignment_clause code where TRACES has one for the same value, and uses a Defra code otherwise.

animalIdentifier.description: One identifier of an individual animal. `typeCode` is from the published list https://codelists.tbc.defra.gov.uk/animal_identifier_types (schemas/codelists/gbn-ag-animal-identifier-types.json): `EAR_TAG`, `PASSPORT`, `MICROCHIP` or `TATTOO`, and `urlId` names that list. `content` is the identifier as written.

tradeProductInstance.description: An individual animal, with its `name` and `permanentLocation` (permanent address). `permanentLocation` is a full `tradeParty`, matching the generic schema (name, postal address and contact details), not an address-only shape.

tradeLineItem.description: A trade line item, including `description`, `scientificName` and `commonName`. `applicableClassification` is an array (`minItems: 1`): the backend currently always produces exactly one, but the generic schema models it as a list. `typeCode` and `urlId` are not carried: they are resolved from CN-code reference data downstream rather than sourced from the notification.
